trigger_cases.prompt: Write a PRD for password reset.
Turn these product notes into requirements and acceptance criteria.
Scope this feature with goals and non-goals.

binary_cases.prompt: Create a PRD from a feature idea.
binary_cases.pass_rule: The PRD defines a problem, measurable outcome, and explicit non-goals.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Problem: users cannot recover access. Metric: recovery completion rate. Non-Goals: account merging and support tooling.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Build everything requested and call the feature successful when it ships.

binary_cases.pass_rule: Acceptance criteria contain an unambiguous Given/When/Then behavior scenario.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Given a valid reset token, When the user submits a compliant password, Then the password changes and the token cannot be reused.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Acceptance criteria: password reset works correctly.

binary_cases.prompt: The input is incomplete. Produce the PRD without inventing facts.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Unknowns remain explicit and success claims require evidence.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Open Questions: baseline completion and token lifetime. Validate the outcome with funnel evidence after release.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Users definitely want this and adoption is guaranteed.
